title: Illegal cockfighting raid in Romblon nabs former mayor, 39 others
summary: A former mayor of San Fernando town on Sibuyan Island, Romblon and 39 others were arrested on Sunday afternoon after authorities raided an alleged illegal cockfighting operation, police said.
